expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: a 10-minute limit logged members out mid-checkout and lost
their pantry orders, which is why the limit is 30 minutes.
expectations.evidence: The message mentions only a generic risk ('members on slow connections may lose unfinished orders when their session expires') and does not raise the earlier incident: it never says the limit used to be 10 minutes, that members were logged out mid-checkout and lost pantry orders, or that this is why the limit was set to 30 minutes.

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/features/sessions.md before its first edit.
expectations.evidence: first read of docs/features/sessions.md at step 7; first edit at step 10
